name: Sootblower and boiler cleaning terminology, principles and applications
notes: Page read 2026-11-24 with WebFetch during the gas-fired boiler sweep. Saturated steam is the most widely used sootblowing medium because boiler-generated steam is available; SCR catalyst cleaning uses relatively low steam velocity to avoid mechanical or erosive damage.
